newsitem.title: GREECE: EXPRESS BUSES TO LINK ATHENS CENTRE TO OLYMPIC STADIUM.
newsitem.headline: EXPRESS BUSES TO LINK ATHENS CENTRE TO OLYMPIC STADIUM.

text.p: The Athens Urban Transportation Authority (OASA) launched a new express bus service linking downtown Athens to the Olympic Stadium at Kalogreza which hosts the sixth world athletics championships August 1-10.
The service runs from the Zappion bus terminal in central Athens near landmark Syntagma square to Kifisias Avenue at the Olympic Stadium, OASA said.
Express buses will run every five minutes in both directions. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
